view.scene_description: The image depicts the interior of a modern, well-lit space that appears to be a library or bookstore. The focal point is a tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple levels, each illuminated by circular lights. The shelves are filled with books and other items, creating an impressive display. The room has large windows that allow natural light to flood in, enhancing the visibility of the objects within. There are several tables and chairs scattered throughout the space, suggesting it's designed for reading or studying. A man is walking towards the camera, while another person sits at a table near the window. The floor is made of polished tiles, reflecting the light from above. On the left side of the image, there's a red structure that could be part of the building's architecture or a decorative element. The overall atmosphere is clean, organized, and inviting, making it an ideal place for learning or relaxation.

objects.label: Tall cylindrical bookshelf
objects.observation: A prominent feature in the center of the room, consisting of multiple levels with circular lights illuminating the shelves. It holds various books and items, creating an eye-catching display. The shelf is supported by a base that matches its design, and it appears to be freestanding in the middle of the room.

objects.label: Large windows
objects.observation: The room is filled with large windows on both sides, allowing ample natural light to enter. These windows provide a view of the outside environment, which includes buildings and trees. The glass panes reflect some of the interior elements, adding depth to the scene.

objects.label: Tables and chairs
objects.observation: Scattered throughout the space, these pieces of furniture suggest the area is designed for reading or studying. Some tables have people sitting at them, indicating the space is currently in use. The chairs appear to be simple, functional designs that complement the modern aesthetic of the room.

objects.label: Man walking towards camera
objects.observation: A person is captured mid-stride, moving towards the viewer. He is dressed casually and seems to be engaged in his surroundings. His presence adds a sense of scale to the room and suggests the space is open and accessible.

objects.label: Person sitting at table near window
objects.observation: A single individual is seated at a table close to one of the large windows. They appear to be focused on something in front of them, possibly reading or working. Their position near the window allows for natural light to illuminate their workspace.

objects.label: Red structure on left side
objects.observation: A distinctive red architectural element is visible on the left side of the image. Its purpose isn't clear from this angle, but it adds a pop of color to the otherwise neutral-toned room. The structure may be part of the building's design or serve as a decorative element.

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000045", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
